messages:
nina-peopleops: Need quick guidance 1: Offer for Mateo (remote EU) - manager requests comp-band uplift band4->band5 and benefits effective 2026-06-01. Payroll earliest enrollment 2026-06-15. Can we approve retro benefits + one-time enrollment gap coverage?

omar-hiring: Candidate accepted verbally. Counteroffer on table. Start date is firm 06/01 to sync with team sprint. Manager wants band5 to match market.

tess-finance: Quick numbers: uplift ~E32,400 annualized. One-time payroll tax adj for 14-day backdate is small (~E350). We need CFO note for any retro >0 days.

rui-legal: We can document a retroactive enrollment if the signed offer shows start date 06/01 and exception is recorded. Recommend capping retro at 14 days and adding audit note.

nina-peopleops: Proposal: provisional band uplift pending CFO, allow benefits to be backdated up to 14 days, HR to arrange temporary vendor health coverage from start if payroll delay >7 days. Approve?

tess-finance: Conditional OK. I'll loop Maria-CFO and produce concise cost delta.

omar-hiring: Candidate is sensitive to benefits start; can we expedite updated offer if CFO ok?

rui-legal: Send signed offer scan with effective 06/01 to legal@redwood. We'll draft exception language.

onboard-bot: Tasks: "get-cfo-approval" -> @tess-finance (due 2026-05-29), "temp-health-setup" -> @nina-peopleops (due 2026-06-01).

tess-finance: Maria (CFO) signed off via DM: approve band uplift and benefits backdate up to 14 days. Finance will absorb one-time payroll adj.

nina-peopleops: Great. Issued revised offer PDF at 10:03 and triggered manual health enrollment for 06/01. Candidate signed at 10:45. Filing exception EXC-2026-091. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
